text:
Sara Liu: heads-up — hit duplicated side-effects in the onboarding sampleapp after a burst of 429s + token rotation. single user, one button press, got two webhook deliveries.

Mike Chen: ugh. do you have a minimal repro or logs?

Sara Liu: repro is tiny. steps: open sampleapp, click `purchase`, force token refresh by rotating creds locally, then flood with 5 quick requests (dev mode). logs show a retry path where client replays after 429 but the server ack got delayed. pasted snippet below: 
```
2026-03-22T14:03:12Z INFO request id=abc123 status=429
2026-03-22T14:03:12Z INFO retrying id=abc123 with Idempotency-Key=missing
2026-03-22T14:03:12Z WARN token rotated during backoff
2026-03-22T14:03:13Z INFO request id=abc123 status=200 side_effect=applied
2026-03-22T14:03:14Z INFO duplicate request id=def456 side_effect=applied
```

Jia Patel: looks like the client didn't attach `Idempotency-Key` on the resumed attempt. which SDK?

Sara Liu: Node sampleapp v0.9.1 (local from master). I think the streaming path for async purchase did a small early-ack + resume flow and our node helper forgot to carry the header into the resumed request.

Mike Chen: hmm we've seen parity gaps: go/python SDKs add replay-guards for non-idempotent ops. Node historically left more to app-level.

Taylor: quick idea: add a lightweight "ack-handoff" handshake where client includes `X-Resume-Token` and server responds `resume-accepted` so replay can be gated. But that touches transport. Another simpler fix: always preserve `Idempotency-Key` across retries (including resumes) and add a server-side dedupe table TTL tied to the safe-replay window.

Sara Liu: agreed on preserving the header. but the hard part is deciding the safe window. observed cases show ~2s windows when token refresh + transient 429 stacked. maybe default 10s with config?

Jia Patel: proposal: default config `safe_replay_window_ms=10000` for sampleapp and SDKs; devex should add a sampleapp integration test that simulates token rotate + 429 and asserts single side-effect. Also add guidance in onboarding docs: "If your flow has token rotation, ensure Idempotency-Key is stored across refresh events."

Mike Chen: implement plan: (1) small Node SDK patch to persist idempotency keys across resume paths, (2) update sampleapp to set `safe_replay_window_ms=10000` and include chaos test in CI, (3) note guidance in quickstart. I'll file a tiny PR for (1).

Taylor: tagging for parity follow-up: we should also run a cross-sdk matrix to confirm go/python/native behavior under same test harness. I can spin up a test job. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI job started: devex/sampleapp#ci-replay-test (runs reproduce-token-rotate-429)

Sara Liu: thanks all — i pushed a minimal repro branch `devex/ack-handoff-repro` and added command in README: `./scripts/run_replay_test.sh`. ping me for access if you can't repro locally.

Mike Chen: awesome. once Node patch lands we should cut a micro-release and add to onboarding changelog.

Jia Patel: will draft the quickstart blurb and update SDK parity checklist.

Taylor: leaving a note to consider telemetry: emit `replay_attempt=1` metric when resume happens so we can detect spikes in duplicate side-effects automatically.

Sara Liu: perfect. I'll watch CI and follow up if the chaos test fails. :eyes:
